resources.string: Choose the server you want to use. Pebrel installs a small encrypted relay over SSH; no Docker, Node.js or domain name is required.

Stops the relay and removes only Pebrel-managed service files. Connected devices will disconnect. Credentials are kept for reinstallation unless you choose to remove them.
Also remove pairing configuration and keys

Linux x64/ARM64, systemd 247+ and root SSH access are currently required. Only one service is installed. Both devices must be able to reach the relay port (443 by default); Pebrel does not change your firewall. Passwords are used only for the selected operation.
Save the connection configuration. On your computer, open Settings → Phone connection → Relay, import the configuration, then generate the QR code for your phone.
